annotations.title: Ownership chain of a UK company

description: Who owns and controls a UK company, up to its ultimate owners: reads the company's register of persons with significant control (Companies House), then the registers of its UK corporate owners, level by level, with cycle protection. Each link gives the kind of control as published, coded and in plain words (e.g. "owns 75% or more of the shares", "can appoint and remove a majority of the directors"). If the register lists no current owner, no_owners_reason says why in plain words (e.g. a listed company exempt under the FCA's DTR 5 rules, or a PSC statement such as "owner exists but not identified"). Individuals are returned by name only, as published. unread_owner_ids lists corporate owners whose registers were not read (depth limit); each can be looked up by its company number. Cost: 1 lookup (same as GET /v1/companies/uk/{company_number}/ownership-chain). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company_number.description: Companies House number, e.g. 00445790 or SC123456; short numbers are zero-padded

name: sisoco_ownership_chain

control.description: The same in plain words, e.g. "owns 75% or more of the shares"

cycle.description: The owner already appears lower in the chain; it is not walked again

natures_of_control.description: Companies House codes for the kind of ownership or control, e.g. ownership-of-shares-75-to-100-percent

types.description: owns (shares or surplus assets) and/or controls (votes, appointments, influence), from the PSC register

exemptions.description: Current exemptions from keeping a PSC register

statements.description: Current PSC statements filed by the company

summary.description: Why the register lists no current owner, in plain words

no_owners_reason.description: Set only when the company has no current owner on its PSC register: the statements and exemptions it has filed instead

registers_read.description: Companies House PSC registers read for this answer (the company's own and its UK corporate owners')

truncated.description: More owners exist beyond max_depth, or some owners' registers could not be read in this call (see unread_owner_ids)

unread_owner_ids.description: UK corporate owners whose own register was not read in this call (read limit or upstream error); call again with their company number to go further

title: Ownership chain of a UK company
